jobs.occupation: Product Owner in the ERP (ARP) /SAP Transformation (d/f/m) (Product Owner)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support ARP Program, Airbus is looking for a

Product Owner in the ERP (ARP) /SAP Transformation (d/f/m)

The ARP Program is the cornerstone of Airbus's digital transformation, aiming to harmonize and optimize our industrial processes across all global sites. We believe this initiative will set new industry standards and significantly enhance our operational efficiency and enable the ramp-up. We're not just implementing SAP; we're reimagining how aerospace manufacturing operates and we drive our E2E flows.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Analyze operational needs through in-depth workshops, shaping our end-to-end Supply Chain and Demand processes.
- Translate complex data into clear documentation and visualizations, driving stakeholder buy-in and team alignment.
- Ensure our processes align with SAP standards and global strategies, driving efficiency and consistency.
- Collaborate with Agile/SAFe Multi-Functional Teams to deliver seamless solutions.
- Potential to lead pioneering projects integrating emerging technologies with SAP solutions.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master’s degree in Informatics, Manufacturing Engineering, or Production/Logistics.
- 8+ years in Aerospace or related complex industries (e.g., Automotive, Defense).
- 5+ years in complex SAP development and deployment
- Deep understanding of SAP modules (MM, PP, SD, EWM), E2E operational processes.
- Proven experience with SAFe/Agile.
- Change Management and Project Management expertise.
- Thrive in demanding, multicultural environments.
- Fluent in English and German
- Willingness to travel, approximately 20% of the time.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

We are looking for a Manager of Commercial Master Data (x|f|m) for the Revenue Operations department. In this role, you will manage commercial master data quality and lifecycle across systems by executing data maintenance, monitoring quality, and clarifying data usage to support reliable commercial execution and enable consistent downstream activities.

The team consists of nine professionals and we are looking forward to shaping the future with you. This position is available for full-time. It is a hybrid role requiring some days on site at our headquarters in Goettingen with the opportunity to work some days remotely.

Please submit your application in English only. Thank you!

Grow With Us – Your Responsibilities

- Execute master data creation, updates, and corrections by applying defined request workflows, validation checks, and approval rules based on agreed data standards to support reliable performance of daily commercial activities
- Monitor data quality by running regular checks on critical fields, analyzing error patterns, tracking recurring inconsistencies and consolidating findings into visible data quality insights to maintain stable, usable master data for consistent operational use
- Clarify correct usage of master data fields by translating agreed definitions into practical guidance and validation rules to ensure consistent data handling across commercial operations
- Assess the impact of master data changes by reviewing affected downstream activities and identifying potential execution risks to prevent disruptions to commercial processes and workflows
- Document and escalate cross-system data inconsistencies by structuring issue descriptions, root causes, and business impact for IT resolution and tracking resolution progress to ensure aligned data usage across systems
- Provide guidance to commercial users on correct data handling by sharing clear instructions and highlighting common error patterns to improve data quality and reduce recurring operational errors

What Will Convince Us

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Life Science, Data Management or related field
- Several years of experience in master data management, commercial operations, or data quality roles
- Deep understanding of data structures and system landscapes
- Strong experience in data maintenance, cleansing, and quality monitoring
- Experience managing high-volume operational data processes with defined SLAs
- Clear understanding of how master data supports commercial execution and reporting
- Ability to communicate and coordinate data-related topics across commercial teams and IT using structured issue definition and escalation
- Solid capability to analyze data issues and translate them into actionable correction measures
- Fluent in English, German and/or Spanish language skills would be beneficial

What We Offer

As a growing global life science company, stock listed on the MDAX and TecDAX, Sartorius offers a wide range of Benefits:

- **Personal and Professional Development:** Mentoring, leadership programs, Talent Talks, internal seminar offerings , coaching for managers
- **Work Life Balance:** Remote options, flextime, flexible work schedules, sabbaticals, Workation
- **Large, Modern Campus:** Open office spaces, terraces, company restaurant with vegetarian and vegan options, cozy Italian bistro with ice cream sales, fitness studio and daycare center
- **Making An Impact Right From The Start:** Comprehensive onboarding, including a virtual online platform even before joining, Welcome Workshops, "buddy" as point of contact
- **Travel Benefits:** Company car (ex. service, sales), car leasing, bike leasing, large free parking garage, good bus connections
- **Welcoming Culture:** Mutual support, teamspirit and international collaboration; communities on numerous topics, such as coaching, agile working and business women network
- This position is filled within the Sartorius Lab Instruments GmbH & Co. KG

We promote diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from people of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religions, age groups, disabilities, and cultural backgrounds.

The Regional Procurement Office (RPO) EMEA is responsible for procurement activities across Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and the Balkans. Within RPO EMEA, the Logistics Procurement Hub manages the sourcing of inland transportation services for wind turbine components, including port handling, factory-to-port transport, and delivery to installation sites. Our diverse and collaborative team supports wind energy projects across the region.

Responsibilities

The Logistics Senior Purchaser (m/f/d) is responsible for leading the sourcing and procurement of transport services for wind turbine components across the EMEA region, ensuring competitive, compliant, and strategically aligned solutions that support both tendering activities and project execution.

The role includes developing sourcing strategies, leading complex RFQs, conducting market analysis, negotiating commercial agreements, and managing supplier performance. The Specialist will work closely with stakeholders across logistics, construction, sales, finance, and legal functions to deliver value, mitigate risks, support business objectives, and contribute to winning projects and successful project execution.

This position is ideal for an experienced procurement professional with a strong commercial mindset, proven negotiation skills, and the ability to independently manage procurement activities in a dynamic international environment.

Key Responsibilities:

- Strategic Sourcing & RFQ Management: Develop and execute sourcing strategies, prepare and manage RFQs, and lead supplier selection processes to ensure competitive and reliable transportation solutions.
- Cost Management & Market Intelligence: Own the development and maintenance of transportation cost models and market benchmarks. Analyze supplier quotations, validate cost structures, and challenge pricing assumptions to ensure competitiveness and transparency. Identify market trends, risks, and opportunities, forecast cost developments, and provide data-driven recommendations that support sourcing strategies, tender activities, and business decisions.
- Bid & Project Support: Play a key role in supporting sales, tendering activities, and project execution by securing competitive transportation solutions, supplier capacity, and commercial insights. Develop accurate cost assessments and recommendations that contribute to winning projects while ensuring successful execution after award.
- Commercial Negotiation & Contract Management: Lead commercial negotiations and support the development of contractual agreements that align with business requirements while mitigating commercial and operational risks.
- Supplier Management & Development: Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships, monitor supplier performance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives related to cost, quality, capacity, and service delivery.
- Compliance & Stakeholder Collaboration: Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and governance requirements while collaborating closely with logistics, construction, finance, legal, and sales stakeholders.

Qualifications

- 5+  years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, or a similar commercial function
- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, International Trade, Economics, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
- German language skills at native speaker level are mandatory; Business-level English proficiency is essential, as all day-to-day communication, reporting, and documentation are conducted in English
- Experience within transport, logistics, heavy haulage, project cargo, infrastructure, energy, or other project-based industries is highly desirable, particularly in the planning and execution of oversized cargo transportation to site. Knowledge of route surveys, road modifications, permit management, and other requirements associated with wind turbine transportation is a strong advantage
- Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with analytical tools, with proven experience in price analysis, cost benchmarking, data interpretation, and identifying opportunities for cost optimization and process improvement
- Experience leading supplier negotiations and managing commercial agreements in a multinational environment
- Strong understanding of sourcing processes, supplier relationship management, contract negotiation, and procurement best practices
- Knowledge of SAP Ariba (Sourcing module) or similar procurement platforms is considered an advantage
- Willingness to travel occasionally across the EMEA region, as required (typically less than 15% of the time)

Competencies

- Strong analytical and commercial mindset with exceptional attention to detail. Comfortable working with data, conducting detailed price and cost comparisons, identifying trends and improvement opportunities, and translating insights into actionable recommendations
- Results-oriented, accountable, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and commitment to delivering objectives
- Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, suppliers, and cultures
- Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and make sound decisions in a dynamic international environment
- Collaborative, adaptable, and easy to work with, fostering open communication and constructive partnerships with colleagues and suppliers

What We Offer 

We offer an exciting opportunity to join one of the world's leading renewable energy companies and play a key role in the procurement of transportation services supporting wind energy projects across the EMEA region. You will work in a highly international environment with significant exposure to strategic sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiations, and cross-functional collaboration. The role offers opportunities for professional growth, responsibility, and direct impact on business performance and project success. 

Your benefits – because your contribution counts!

- Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects 
- Development & Skills: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth
- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, 30 days of vacation plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off, and the option for a sabbatical 
- Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) 
- Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and great team spirit

jobs.occupation: Head of Strategy (x|f|m) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description:
Growth and ideas that simplify progress. Join Sartorius as our Head of Strategy (x|f|m) based at our headquarters in Goettingen and help shape the direction of a global life science leader. Reporting to our CEO and working closely with the Executive Board, this role drives enterprise-wide strategic priorities, governance, and decision-making — ensuring the initiatives that matter most are translated into action through effective cross-functional coordination, dependency resolution, and long-term impact. You will lead a team of senior experts being part of the solution by helping turn strategy into measurable progress.

Grow With Us – Your Responsibilities

- Steer enterprise portfolio governance and strategic prioritization, enabling transparent, evidence-based prioritization and resource allocation across the enterprise portfolio, including structured evaluations of strategic growth opportunities beyond mergers and acquisitions
- Lead the annual strategic planning cycle and Executive Board governance cadence to ensure the timely delivery of strategy reviews, offsites, and decision-ready materials
- Challenge assumptions and foster cross-functional strategic alignment to enable coherent, fact-based decisions across stakeholders while strengthening collaboration and decision quality
- Conduct early-stage strategic assessments of growth opportunities, including partnerships and new business ideas, to support Executive Board discussions and decision-making
- Support the Executive Board with focused ad hoc strategic analyses that enhance transparency and strengthen enterprise-level decision-making on priority topics
- Translate strategic priorities into structured initiative charters with clear milestones, ownership, and visibility of risks and actions while coordinating resolution of cross-functional dependencies and implementation risks, to support effective execution
- Maintain the enterprise strategic architecture, including frameworks, templates, and standards, ensuring consistent application of high-quality strategic methodologies across functions

What Will Convince Us

- Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Life Sciences or a related field; an MBA is required
- Strong track record and several years of experience in corporate strategy, top-tier consulting, portfolio governance, strategic opportunity assessment, or related areas
- Demonstrate strong analytical synthesis capabilities and structured problem-solving skills combined with the ability to communicate effectively at Executive Board level
- Exhibit a proven track record of constructively challenging assumptions while aligning senior stakeholders around strategic priorities
- Apply an outstanding ability to collaborate across functions and influence decisions without formal authority
- Possess experience managing enterprise planning cycles, strategic governance processes, and prioritization frameworks
- Solid understanding of financial statements and business performance metrics
- High proficiency in English language

What We Offer

As a growing global life science company, stock listed on the MDAX and TecDAX, Sartorius offers a wide range of Benefits:

- **Contribute to our Growth Journey:** In this position, you will have the chance to actively contribute shaping the organizations strategy
- **Welcoming Culture:** Mutual support, team spirit and international collaboration; communities on numerous topics
- **Personal and Professional Development:** Mentoring, leadership programs, Talent Talks, internal seminar offerings
- **Large, Modern Campus:** Open office spaces, terraces, company restaurant with vegetarian and vegan options, cozy Italian bistro, fitness studio and daycare center
- **Making An Impact Right From The Start:** Comprehensive onboarding, including a virtual online platform even before joining, Welcome Workshops
- This position is filled within the Sartorius Corporate Administration GmbH

Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The Opportunity

Worldline is an international company with branches and subsidiaries in several countries within the European Union. As a regulated Payment Institution it is important to have good oversight over the activities in the whole group. We are looking for a Financial Crime Compliance Specialist with experience in an international context to organize and improve this oversight.
This specialist must have profound knowledge of the European and German legislation. Knowledge of other European legislation (Luxembourg, Netherlands, UK, Nordics, Czech,…) is a plus.
We are looking for a professional with profound Financial Crime Compliance knowledge and experience, preferably within the Payments Industry. 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

- You organize international oversight within the Worldline NV/SA Group for Financial Crime Compliance
- You keep track of regulatory and industry Financial Crime standards and requirements in an international context.
- You prepare reporting to Management and to the authorities
- You perform compliance risk assessments.
- You advise Management and stakeholders on KYC, AML/CFT and Sanctions and regulatory related risks and requirements.
- You prepare training on FCC topics
- You keep relevant KYC, AML/CFT and Sanctions policies, guidelines, procedures and work instructions up to date in alignment with regulations and group policies.
- You conduct and support the performance of 2nd line controls and assessments. You assess the controls executed by 1st line
- You analyze transaction monitoring alerts reported by 1st line and report irregularities indicative of money laundering or terrorist financing to the authorities.
- You are a pro-active team player who can work independently and is focused on delivery and quality.
- You ensure compliance with international law and regulations (AML/CFT, Sanctions) and protect the company from being used for these activities.
- You actively participate in challenging Compliance projects.
- You prove integrity and professional ethics.
- You have a strong compliance focus, while looking for improved efficiency 

Who Are We Looking For

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:

-   You have a university degree in either law, finance, business administration or a related field, or equivalent through experience
- Preferably a completed certification course on one the themes from a renowned international organisation such as ACAMS, IIA.
- You have experience in an AML/CFT compliance role.
- You have strong attention to detail in order to identify and correct risky practices.
- You possess excellent analytical skills and the ability to accurately interpret complex legislation, documents and policies.
- You have strong presentation and problem-solving skills.
- You have a strong knowledge of relevant supervision laws i.e. PSD2, EU AML legislative framework, local (at least German) Anti-Money Laundering Act and Sanctions laws.
- You are proficient in the use of Microsoft-Office Products.
- You master statistical analysis and research.
- You have a solid understanding of business processes in the payment and e-transaction field.
- You have experience with good practices for information sharing (e.g. in SharePoint, Teams, OneNote, JIRA,…)
- You have excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
- You have good communication skills in German
- You have a Multicultural mindset and flexibility, able to work in an international and constantly evolving environment

jobs.occupation: Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft Offshore-Windkraftanlagen (m/f/d) (Techniker/in - Windenergietechnik/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description:
Imagine a future where you play a key role in ensuring electrical safety across our offshore substations and wind turbines while helping us push the boundaries of safe, efficient, and reliable offshore operations.

Join us in this role where you’ll take independent ownership of electrical safety within your area of responsibility, overseeing electrical installations on wind turbines in our German wind farms. You’ll combine your deep technical expertise with on-site presence—both at your permanent base in Norddeich and offshore—in order to guide colleagues, strengthen procedures, and ensure safe systems of work.

Welcome to HV and Transmission GER

You’ll be part of HV and Transmission GER, where you and your colleagues will ensure electrical safety governance and operational support across high-voltage infrastructure in our German offshore wind farms. Your team is dedicated to managing safety-critical systems, uplifting operational standards, and sharing expertise across the organisation.

As a team, we collaborate closely, support one another’s development, and bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to every challenge.

You’ll play an important role in:

- preparing and reviewing risk assessments for offshore electrical work
- supporting the selection, training, and supervision of Authorised Persons, electricians, and electrically instructed persons offshore
- contributing to the qualification and supervision of contractors in the offshore electrical environment
- developing, implementing, and improving maintenance plans for offshore electrical installations
- coordinating multiple employers involved in offshore electrical activities
- planning, organising, delivering, and documenting electrical safety training
- implementing, strengthening, and regularly reviewing the Wind Turbine Safety Rules (WTSR) and Orsted Electrical Safety Rules (OESR)
- assuming designated roles within the Safe Systems of Work, such as Authorising Engineer, Authorising Officer, or Training Mentor
- auditing work processes before offshore deployment.

To succeed in the role, you:

- have completed a degree within electrical engineering, or equivalent
- bring strong expertise within electrical safety, including standards, laws, and regulations
- demonstrate technical leadership competence
- offer switching experience in high-voltage environments above 20 kV
- communicate confidently in both English and German at B2 level or higher
- are comfortable using IT systems, including Microsoft Office, SAP, and AI tools
- ideally have a qualification for live working, experience with wind turbines, or prior responsibility as an electrician
- meet the minimum competency requirements within your onboarding timeframe, supported by our learning and development processes.

**Country-specific requirements: **fulfil the requirements of a responsible electrician (vEFK) according to VDE 1000-10.

Please note that in this role you will be mainly working in our office in Norddeich from Monday to Friday. An important part of the role will be an inspection of plants and the professional guidance of the electricians. This requires partial work offshore (20-40%) in a 7- or 14-day shift pattern.

jobs.occupation: PhD positions - Statistical Physics and Active Matter - (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
In the Department of Living Matter Physics (LMP) we seek to fill a number of

PhD positions.

- Statistical Physics and Active Matter -

The Max Planck Institute for Dynamics and Self-Organization (MPI-DS) at Göttingen, Germany, is an international, interdisciplinary and collaborative environment offering an exceptional research setting. It hosts a range of theoretical and experimental fundamental scientific research and a diverse group of researchers. Altogether, it employs about 300 people. 

The LMP department engages in a wide range of theoretical research aimed at understanding the dynamics of living systems from a physical perspective. The department is headed by Ramin Golestanian and hosts a number of group leaders, postdoctoral researchers, students, and visitors.

The research

The PhD students will engage in theoretical and/or computational research in Nonequilibrium Statistical Physics and Active Matter, under the supervision of Ramin Golestanian. For more information concerning our current areas of research activity, visit our website (http://www.ds.mpg.de/lmp (http://www.ds.mpg.de/lmp) ).

Your profile

We are looking for excellent, enthusiastic and self-motivated early-career researchers with good communication skills to join our research team. 

The PhD candidate should have:

- A Master’s degree (or comparable) in theoretical physics, applied mathematics or related disciplines from a recognized university;
- Strong interest in nonequilibrium statistical physics and the physics of living systems across scales;
- Ability and desire to work in an international team on inter-disciplinary research topics;
- Good command of English, which is the working language of the department. German is an asset but not required.

Our offer

We are offering excellent working conditions in a highly interdisciplinary and stimulating research environment. Salary and working hours are in accordance with the funding guidelines of the Max Planck Society for junior scientists. Working hours are fulltime; salary is 2/3 of E13 TVöD-Bund. Furthermore, we offer opportunities regarding work life balance as well as health promotion services. The PhD position is limited to three years. The starting date is flexible.

The Max-Planck Society is committed to achieving the highest level of excellence and diversity. We encourage applications from women, especially in areas where they are underrepresented, which includes theoretical physics. Moreover, we are committed to providing suitable working environment for everyone including individuals with disabilities.

Your application

To apply, please follow this link (https://jobs.b-ite.com/en/jobposting/64bbb9935c7fc269f86d9f96bf4a8e06636784110/apply)  and submit your CV, your academic records, a statement of your research interests, and contacts of two referees. Processing of applications will start after the deadline of 1st December 2026. While we may continue to receive applications until 1st April 2027, the positions will be filled as soon as suitable candidates are identified. Therefore, you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: TRI/TRE A220 (type-rated and non-type-rated, all genders) (Chefpilot/in)
jobs.description:
As a captain and TRI/TRE, you are characterized by openness, professionalism and pragmatism. You are a team player and take responsibility for your decisions. You love flying and are keen to explore new and exciting routes in all parts of Europe. In addition.

- ...you operate the Lufthansa City Airlines aircrafts safely and efficiently
- ...you act responsibly and sustainably
- ...you are willing and keen to actively shape Lufthansa City Airlines

Ihr Profil:

In addition to your strong decision-making skills and ability to work in a team, you will need the following for this vacancy:

- EASA ATPL(A)
- Valid CS-25 Type Rating
- Valid TRI/TRE qualification (A220 TRI/TRE qualification is preferred - but not mandatory)
- Proven experience as an instructor
- Min. 5000h total flight hours and min. 1000h PIC h on CS-25 aircraft
- Medical Class I
- General higher education entrance qualification (Abitur/ Fachhochschulreife or equivalent qualification)
- EU citizenship or unrestricted residence and work permit
- Passport with unlimited validity (if no EU passport is available, there must be no stricter entry restrictions than with an EU passport)
- Confident verbal and written language skills in English (at least ICAO Language Proficiency Level 4)

Selection is based on Selection standards of Lufthansa City Airlines. Recognition of Lufthansa Group selection procedures is possible.

What to expect
• You own our native mobile end-to-end test automation stack (Maestro, iOS and Android), taking ownership of architecture, conventions, and suite health. You keep the suite small, deterministic, and cross-platform, because a reliable smoke and regression suite beats a large, flaky one.
• You design and operate AI-driven test workflows where agents generate Maestro flows from specs and test cases (TestRail, Confluence), self-heal selectors, and triage failures. You review and harden everything the agents produce.
• You drive testability into the product and build deterministic test foundations through stubbing, fixtures, and contract tests.
• You own our CI quality gates (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and define where the test-pyramid boundary sits.
• You review and elevate the work of our developers and manual QA, coaching them on writing testable code and on reviewing AI-generated tests.
• You extend automation to our web stack (Playwright, Angular) where it adds value, always keeping the overall suite lean and reliable.

Your background
• You have 5+ years in test automation or SDET roles, with at least two of them owning test infrastructure (frameworks, CI, environments, test data), not just authoring suites.
• You have delivered native mobile end-to-end automation on real projects (Maestro, Appium, XCUITest, or Espresso) and can explain the flakiness trade-offs between them.
• You bring developer-level scripting and programming ability (Kotlin, Swift, TypeScript, or Python) and read app code to add testability hooks yourself.
• You have hands-on experience with LLM and agent tooling (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) in a testing workflow, or credible evidence that you will adopt it fast. This is core to the role, not a nice-to-have.
• You have a clear stance on test-data determinism through stubbing, fixtures, and contract tests, and you have a proven track record of eliminating flakiness and keeping suites deterministic.
• You ideally bring experience in CI/CD pipeline ownership (including device farms and simulators), web E2E with Playwright, white-label or multi-tenant product experience, visual and snapshot regression testing, and TestRail integration and reporting.
• You communicate clearly in English and collaborate well with Product Owners and cross-functional teams.

What we offer
• The opportunity to develop freely in a growing company within a dynamic industry, shape the future, and continuously develop yourself.
• The chance to take on responsibility from day one and leverage our short and fast decision-making processes to make an impact.
• Flexible working hours based on trust and 30 days of vacation.
• The possibility to work remotely several days per week.
• An attractive, competitive salary and a variety of additional benefits (HVV ProfiCard, pension subsidy, etc.).

About usThe energy transition is one of our most important public projects. More than 1,000 municipal utilities and energy suppliers in Germany are working hard to supply our electricity in an ecologically and economically sustainable way.
